verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI ships a documented 'Pull Request Reviews' feature (automated code review with contextual feedback/suggestions) and can query/act on PRs via GitHub integration, and community feedback (comm-20) corroborates it catching bugs reviewers missed. However, there's no first-party evidence of a dedicated diff-viewing UX or running test/lint 'checks' before merge, and some community reports describe agentic unreliability and looping errors that undercut trust in pre-merge safety workflows. Missing for 10: explicit diff-inspection tooling, integration with CI/test-check execution, and stronger reliability corroboration.
